explanation: Sum the euros first. Pocket revenue = 30 × (720 - 24) + 60 × (135 - 6) = 20,880 + 7,740 = 28,620 euros. List value = 30 × 800 + 60 × 150 = 33,000 euros. Realisation = 100 × 28,620 / 33,000 = 86.7%. The average of the two products' rates, 87.0% and 86.0%, gives 86.5%, which weighs the docking stations as much as the laptops; invoice prices alone give 90.0%.
